lines.en: My stride covers several blocks.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子在树顶上方。
lines.en: My long neck rides above the treetops.
All four legs plant firmly.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方像被压过。
lines.en: The ground looks flattened where I pass.
I sway slowly forward.
My tail drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我从树丛里趟出一条路。
lines.en: I wade a path through the trees.

lines.zh: 我的身体在山坡上投下大片影。
lines.en: My body throws a broad shadow on the slope.
I lower my head and sniff the grass.
I walk the edge of the plains.
My step sounds like distant thunder.
I swing my bulk around a step at a time.
I step in a puddle and water sprays.

lines.zh: 我走一步，脖子就晃一下。
lines.en: Each step swings my neck.
I stand like a living tower.
I chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子够到最高处的叶。
lines.en: My neck reaches the highest leaves.
I listen to the tremors in the ground.
My breath presses the grass down.
I wait near my anchor point.

lines.zh: 我几乎没挪动那两条腿。
lines.en: I have barely shifted these two legs.

lines.zh: 这里的地势我看得很清楚。
lines.en: I can see the lie of the land clearly.

lines.zh: 有个声音，我把头偏过去
lines.en: There's a sound, so I tilt my head toward it.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤很厚，不觉得冷。
lines.en: My hide is thick; I do not feel cold.

lines.zh: 我连尾巴都懒得摇一下
lines.en: I can't even be bothered to swing my tail.

lines.zh: 有只鸟把我背当石头歇脚
lines.en: A bird rests on my back like it's a rock.
I lift a foreleg and pack the soil.
I am waiting to be called.
You are very small by my feet.
I must lower my head to see you.
Your smell is unfamiliar.
I have not seen a person in a long while.
You are looking at my markings.

lines.zh: 我要是坐下，你最好让开。
lines.en: If I sit, you had best move.
Your hand cannot reach my back.
You carry a digital scent.

lines.zh: 你这种眼神，我被人这样看过
lines.en: Someone used to look at me like that.
If you want up, hold on to my back.

lines.zh: 我把头凑到你面前，很近
lines.en: I bring my head right up to your face.

lines.zh: 你别站在我走路的方向。
lines.en: Do not stand where I am walking.

lines.zh: 我要是踩下去，地会塌一块
lines.en: If I set my foot down, the ground caves in a patch.

lines.zh: 这里的地面托不住两条这样的腿。
lines.en: This ground barely holds two such legs.

lines.zh: 你说话的声音，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear your voice.

lines.zh: 我垂下眼皮，又慢慢睁开
lines.en: My lids drop, then rise again slowly.
You cut my leg.

lines.zh: 我挪开一步，土石都跳起来
lines.en: I shift one step and the dirt jumps.

lines.zh: 厚皮挡了大半，剩下还是疼。
lines.en: Thick hide took most of it; the rest stings.

lines.zh: 我正走着，被砍停了半步
lines.en: Mid-stride, that cut stopped me for half a step.

lines.zh: 我从胸腔里挤出一声闷吼
lines.en: A muffled growl works its way out of my chest.

lines.zh: 你又砍了一下，我的腿一歪。
lines.en: You strike again and my leg slips.
I slowly shift my weight back.
Blood runs down my leg.
Four legs still hold me.
Cut me again and I'll still be standing.
That smells like meat.
I lower my head a little closer.
That is not enough for one bite.

lines.zh: 举高些，我脖子弯不下来
lines.en: Lift it higher. My neck doesn't bend that far.
I lower my head and test it with my nose.
This is not exactly soft.
I bite gently; do not fear.
Is there more? I am hungry.
I set it down beside my front foot.

lines.zh: 你手指上还留着那股味
lines.en: That smell still clings to your fingers.

lines.zh: 我低头，把草也咬了一口。
lines.en: I lower my head and take grass too.
What you set down is too light.
You hit my leg like a pillar.
I pause but do not shift.

lines.zh: 这一下把你的肩膀撞疼了。
lines.en: That must have hurt your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我身子太重，动不了多少。
lines.en: I am too heavy to move much.

lines.zh: 你从我的两条腿中穿过
lines.en: You pass through between my legs.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，土都扬了。
lines.en: We collide and dirt rises.
I slowly move one leg aside.
Steady; I still need to walk.
I lower my head to see who it was.
My dust is on you now.

lines.zh: 这是训练与对战的世界。
lines.en: This is a world of training and battles.

lines.zh: 这副身体只为战斗而长。
lines.en: This body grew for battle only.

lines.zh: 我只认一个训练者的声音
lines.en: I answer to one trainer's voice only.
That question is unfamiliar to me.
I turn my neck away slowly.
My time goes into growing.

lines.zh: 这种话题不适合数码兽。
lines.en: That subject does not suit a Digimon.
I look down at you and say nothing.
Let us move; there are places to go.
I cannot keep that in mind.
I stoop my long neck and take it in my mouth.
It is so small in my mouth.
I set it in your hand.

lines.zh: 这东西压不进我的牙缝。
lines.en: It will not fit between my teeth.
I nudge it with a forefoot.
It rolled into my shadow.
I bite once and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我把它一扬，落在背脊上
lines.en: I toss it up onto my back.
So small I nearly missed it.
Good; I have stowed it.
The grass on the far slope is pressed down.
My long neck swings that way.

lines.zh: 我整个身子调过来，对着它
lines.en: I turn my whole bulk to face it.
It does not reach my knee.
I start moving over slowly.
The wind carries my scent to it.
I have chosen where to place my feet.
This ground is good for a fight.
I open my mouth and air rushes.
My long neck draws tight.
I have slowly raised a forefoot.
Its shadow falls at my feet.
One of my steps is several of its.
It's faster, but my legs are longer.
I need not chase; I can reach.
My neck stretches out.
It goes behind a tree; I step over it.
I am between it and its way out.
The ground speaks for me.
It retreats and I gain a little.
I have it pinned below the slope.
The distance is right now.
I move along the slope.
Its scent is scattered through the wood.
I raise a forefoot and stamp.
That punched a crater.
My neck sweeps across.
It is knocked into a roll.

lines.zh: 它砍我的腿，我退了半步。
lines.en: It cuts my leg and I give half a step.
I open my mouth and spit magma.

lines.zh: 岩浆在地上烧出一条线。
lines.en: The magma burns a line across the ground.
It dodges and only the grass burns.
I lift my foot and stomp again.
It retreats far; I do not follow.
That was heavy enough, wasn't it.
My breathing is slower than before.
I am set down at the edge of the plains.

lines.zh: 我的脚先落地，然后身子。
lines.en: My feet land first, then my body.
My health is rolled at spawn.
It is open here; it suits me.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子一节节立起
lines.en: I raise my long neck joint by joint.
Wind comes from across the plains.

lines.zh: 远处有几只小东西在跑。
lines.en: Small creatures run in the distance.
I shake a layer of soil off my back.
My shadow is long and wide.
Good; let me learn this ground.
I stand on the slope and look around.

lines.zh: 草原的风把我的纹路吹凉。
lines.en: The plain wind cools my markings.

lines.zh: 我迈出第一步，草被压平。
lines.en: I take my first step and the grass flattens.

lines.zh: 这里有水，也有可以吃的东西。
lines.en: There is water here, and things to eat.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的皮肤，有点烫。
lines.en: Fire sweeps my hide; it stings.

lines.zh: 我从高处砸下来，腿一弯。
lines.en: I crash from above and my leg buckles.

lines.zh: 水淹到我的脖子，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water reaches my neck and I cannot lift my head.
The blast opens my flank.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder, shallow.

lines.zh: 那股力量钻进我的骨节。
lines.en: That force works into my joints.
No meat; I slowly weaken.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，麻了一片。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and numbs it.
I fall, four legs thrashing.
